lines.en: label beachsix3:
scene clearnightsky
Now that I have expelled my demons, I am free to roam these sands undisturbed. Or at least until something {i}else{/i} haunts me along the way.
lines.zh: 既然我已经把自己的心魔赶了出去，就可以不受打扰地在这片沙滩上游荡了。至少在别的什么{i}东西{/i}在路上缠上我之前是这样。

lines.en: Most of the girls have already gone back to their rooms. I heard their chatter as I slithered through the halls on the way outside.
lines.zh: 大部分女孩已经回房间了。我溜出走廊的路上听到了她们的说笑声。

lines.en: But somewhat surprisingly, it seems as if they’ve given up on coming to find me after the initial excitement wore off.
lines.zh: 但有点意外的是，最初的兴奋劲儿过去之后，她们似乎已经放弃了来找我的打算。

lines.en: Perhaps I’m just boring now. Or perhaps they’re afraid of what they’ll find.
lines.zh: 也许我现在就是这么无聊。也许她们害怕自己会撞见什么。

lines.en: Hell, I’d say it’s even possible at this point that they’ve come to some sort of formal agreement to stop pursuing my penis all together after a certain time during beach trips from now on.
lines.zh: 见鬼，我觉得甚至有可能是她们达成了某种正式协议：从今往后，海滩之旅过了某个时间点就一律不再追着我的鸡巴跑。

lines.en: If that’s the case, I am glad to have exhausted myself so early.
lines.zh: 如果是这样，我很庆幸自己这么早就精疲力竭了。

lines.en: I am {i}not{/i} glad, however, that just minutes after mentioning that I am free to roam the sands undisturbed, I have already encountered my first ghost.
lines.zh: 但我{i}不{/i}庆幸的是，就在我说完可以自由自在地在沙滩上游荡几分钟后，我已经撞见了我的第一个幽灵。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach1
And here I was thinking that I {i}wouldn’t{/i} come across her — and that our awkward conversation through text would fade into the ether with the remnants of my forced optimism.
lines.zh: 而我明明以为自己{i}不会{/i}碰上她的——以为我们那场尴尬的短信对话会随着我强撑的乐观残骸一起消散在虚空里。

lines.en: I {i}could{/i} just turn around and leave.
lines.zh: 我{i}本来{/i}可以转身就走。

lines.en: But I suppose I {i}also{/i} could have sodomized her right there in the karaoke booth and been in essentially the same situation now that someone handed her an excuse on a silver platter.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我{i}也{/i}本可以就在那个卡拉 OK 包厢里把她给鸡奸了，然后落到现在这个基本一样的处境——既然有人把借口端在银盘子上递给了她。

lines.en: It was the last thing she needed, but the first thing she used. And of course I will once again reap the benefits of that. And the two of us will make up.
lines.zh: 那是她最不需要的东西，却是她第一个用上的东西。而我当然会再一次从中渔利。而我们两个会和好。

lines.en: And slowly, over time, she will become less perturbed by the man I am and more likely to welcome me in ways she’ll neglect to ever tell her parents.
lines.zh: 然后慢慢地，随着时间推移，她会越来越不为我这个人所困扰，也越来越可能用一些她永远不会告诉父母的方式来接纳我。

lines.en: And I hate it.
lines.zh: 而我恨这个。

lines.en: I {i}despise{/i} it.
lines.zh: 我{i}憎恨{/i}这个。

lines.en: I have won a battle I conceded. One I left behind. But someone went in and redacted the loss and now we’re right back at the start.
lines.zh: 我赢下了一场我早已认输的战斗。一场我已经放下的战斗。可有人闯进去把那场败绩抹掉了，于是我们又回到了起点。

lines.en: So I suppose it’s time to begin again then. Approach her and work my way back up — but it’s not like I’ll have to work very hard.
lines.zh: 那么我想，是时候重新开始了。靠近她，一步步走回去——不过我大概也不用太费力。

lines.en: She will sing for me whether she likes it or not.
lines.zh: 不管她愿不愿意，她都会为我歌唱。

lines.en: And I will mimic her cries the way this family of marsh warblers does.
lines.zh: 而我会像这群湿地苇莺一样，模仿她的鸣叫。

lines.en: scene black
For that is the only way we can ever feel like we fit in.
lines.zh: 因为这是我们唯一能感到自己融入其中的方式。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach2
: Hey, Senpai! I thought I heard somebody sneaking up on us back there. Was worried for a second that all those Belarusian assassins were hot on my trail again.
lines.zh: 嘿，Senpai！我刚才好像听到有人在我们后面鬼鬼祟祟。有一瞬间还担心是不是那群白俄罗斯刺客又追上我了。

lines.en: : They are — and I am one of them. After all these years, I have finally obtained enough information to confirm that I am, in fact, going to kill you now.
lines.zh: 是的——而我是其中之一。这么多年过去，我终于掌握了足够的情报，可以确认：我现在就要来杀你了。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach3
: Please, Senpai! At {i}least{/i} spare my child! I swear that she is innocent and does not deserve the same fate as me!
lines.zh: 求你了，Senpai！{i}至少{/i}放过我的孩子吧！我发誓她是无辜的，不该落得和我一样的下场！

lines.en: : At least not yet, she doesn’t! But who {i}knows{/i} what will happen once her mother is taken back to Belarus!
lines.zh: 至少现在还不该！不过等我母亲被带回白俄罗斯之后，{i}谁又知道{/i}会发生什么呢！

lines.en: : You’ve never even been to Belarus...have you, Miss Imai?
lines.zh: 你根本没去过白俄罗斯……对吧，Imai 老师？

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach4
: I ain’t gonna lie to you, Karin. I probably couldn’t even point it out on a map.
lines.zh: 我不骗你，Karin。我大概连在地图上指出来都做不到。

lines.en: : But you didn’t hear that from me since I feel like it’s only a matter of time until they add geography to the curriculum and I ain’t trying to lose my job.
lines.zh: 不过这话你可别说是听我说的，因为我觉得他们迟早会把地理加进课程里，我可不想丢了工作。

lines.en: : Speaking of which — good job so far, but you’re fired.
lines.zh: 说到这个——目前干得不错，不过你被开除了。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach5
: Damn it! This is all Karin’s fault, isn’t it?!
lines.zh: 该死！这全是 Karin 的错，对吧？！

lines.en: : Just part of the assassination contract, unfortunately. Karin is now and always {i}will{/i} be innocent.
lines.zh: 很遗憾，这只是刺杀合同的一部分。Karin 现在、而且{i}永远{/i}都是无辜的。

lines.en: : That said, though...can I make a request, Imani?
lines.zh: 不过话说回来……我能提个请求吗，Imani？

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach6
: Jeez, Senpai. Right in front of my daughter? Isn’t that a little {i}forward?{/i}
lines.zh: 天哪，Senpai。当着我女儿的面？这不是有点{i}太直接{/i}了吗？

lines.en: : I was actually wondering if I could talk {i}to{/i} your daughter. Alone.
lines.zh: 我其实想问能不能跟你女儿{i}单独{/i}谈谈。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach7
: ...What?
lines.zh: ……什么？

lines.en: : In the middle of the night? Why? We were just about to head back to the inn.
lines.zh: 大半夜的？为什么？我们正准备回旅馆呢。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach8
: I actually...asked Sensei if he could talk to me in private. It’s...something to do with my parents. He met them back when he used to...coach the soccer team.
lines.zh: 其实……是我请 Sensei 私下跟我谈的。是……跟我父母有关的事。他以前……带足球队的时候见过他们。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene karinnightbeach9
: How come you’ve never mentioned that before, Senpai?
lines.zh: 你怎么从来没提过这个，Senpai？

lines.en: : Probably because Karin’s parents aren’t a very interesting or relevant conversation topic.
lines.zh: 大概因为 Karin 的父母不是什么有趣或相关的话题。

lines.en: : Well, just...don’t keep her out too late, you hear? This girl needs her beauty sleep or you’ll be potentially interfering with the body of a future Olympian.
lines.zh: 那……别把她留太晚，听到了吗？这姑娘需要她的美容觉，不然你可能会妨碍到一位未来奥运选手的身体发育。

lines.en: : Oh, stop...I’m not nearly {i}that{/i} good at anything.
lines.zh: 哦，别说了……我在任何事上都没{i}那么{/i}厉害。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach10
: Either way, uh...call me if you need me. Okay?
lines.zh: 不管怎样，呃……需要的话给我打电话。好吗？

lines.en: : I...left my phone in the room.
lines.zh: 我……把手机落在房间里了。

lines.en: : Then yell {i}very{/i} loudly.
lines.zh: 那就{i}非常{/i}大声地喊。

lines.en: scene black
: G’night, you two! Don’t stay out too- oh. I already said that, didn’t I?
lines.zh: 晚安，你们两个！别待太——哦。我已经说过这句了，对吧？

lines.en: : Bye!
lines.zh: 再见！

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach11
: I didn’t expect you to lie for me back there, Karin. In fact, I didn’t realize you even {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: 我没想到你会替我撒谎，Karin。事实上，我都没想到你{i}居然会{/i}撒谎。

lines.en: : It’s not like you left me much of a choice, Sensei.
lines.zh: 你也没给我留多少选择，Sensei。

lines.en: : Imani’s obviously going to think something is weird if you ask to be alone with me in the middle of the night. Not every teacher is as...{i}open{/i} to doing that as you.
lines.zh: 如果你要求大半夜跟我独处，Imani 显然会觉得哪里不对劲。不是每个老师都像你这么{i}开放{/i}。

lines.en: : Just doing what you asked of me, Karin. You’re the one who wanted to talk again. And you said yourself that you wouldn’t be able to approach me.
lines.zh: 我只是照你说的做，Karin。是你想再谈一次。而且你自己也说了你没办法主动靠近我。

lines.en: : Yes, but couldn’t you have approached me during the day instead? That’d be way less suspicious.
lines.zh: 是，可你就不能白天来找我吗？那样就没那么可疑了。

lines.en: : I was busy...sorry.
lines.zh: 我忙着呢……抱歉。

lines.en: : Yeah, so was Kirin. I wonder if that’s a coincidence.
lines.zh: 是啊，Kirin 也忙着呢。我在想这是不是巧合。

lines.en: : Having buyer’s remorse already? Wish you never texted me at all?
lines.zh: 已经开始后悔了？希望自己根本没给我发过短信？

lines.en: : I wish I never {i}met{/i} you at all.
lines.zh: 我倒是希望自己根本{i}没遇到过{/i}你。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach12
: But only...
lines.zh: 但只是……

lines.en: : Only because things were so much easier before I knew you.
lines.zh: 只是因为在我认识你之前，一切都简单太多了。

lines.en: : Well...can’t say I don’t agree with that. Sorry about the Olympics.
lines.zh: 嗯……我得说我同意这点。奥运会的事我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach13
: I...I’m obviously not talking about the Olympics! I’m talking about how you make me feel...weird! And not the good kind of weird either! The mostly bad kind!
lines.zh: 我……我说的显然不是奥运会！我说的是你让我感觉很……奇怪！而且还不是好的那种奇怪！基本都是坏的！

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach14
: Which...isn’t to say there’s {i}never{/i} been any of the good kind! But I still don’t really understand what the good kind is and I sure as heck don’t think that any of this is-
lines.zh: 不过……也不是说{i}从来没有{/i}过好的那种！可我还是不太明白好的那种是什么，而且我肯定不觉得这一切是-

lines.en: : Karin, I get it. You don’t need to try and explain {i}your{/i} position to me when I’m the one who put you there, remember? I know where you stand better than anyone.
lines.zh: Karin，我明白。你不需要向我解释{i}你{/i}的立场，毕竟把你放到那个位置上的人是我，记得吗？我比任何人都清楚你站在哪里。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach15
: Then...
lines.zh: 那么……

lines.en: : Then would you mind telling {i}me?{/i} Because I really can’t figure out what I’m supposed to do with you now...
lines.zh: 那你能不能告诉{i}我{/i}？因为我真的搞不清现在该拿你怎么办……

lines.en: : That makes it sound like I’m some kind of tool. Which I won’t outright deny — I just didn’t expect to hear it from you.
lines.zh: 这话说得我像是什么工具。我不会直接否认——只是没想到会从你嘴里听到。

lines.en: : I’m not calling you a tool...I’m saying that if what you did really was out of your control...isn’t it wrong for me to hold that against you? Or am I just acting crazy?
lines.zh: 我不是在叫你工具……我是说，如果你做的那些事真的不受你控制……那我因此记恨你，是不是不对？还是说我只是在犯疯？

lines.en: : The thing is, Karin...even if that {i}was{/i} out of my control...
lines.zh: 问题是，Karin……就算那{i}真的{/i}不受我控制……

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach16
: It was born from somewhere real. And I doubt it would’ve happened if I hadn’t felt a certain {i}explicit{/i} way about you.
lines.zh: 它也是从某个真实的地方生出来的。而且我怀疑，如果我不是对你抱有某种{i}明确的{/i}感觉，它根本不会发生。

lines.en: : And that’s supposed to make me feel {i}better?{/i} You’re really bad at this.
lines.zh: 那是为了让我感觉{i}更好{/i}吗？你真的太不会说话了。

lines.en: : I’m bad at it because I’m specifically {i}not{/i} trying to make you feel better. But yeah. I guess I’d still probably suck at it even if I was.
lines.zh: 我不会说话，是因为我{i}特意{/i}没想让你好受。不过是啊。就算我想，我大概也还是很烂。

lines.en: : How do you feel now then? Do you think it might happen again?
lines.zh: 那你现在是什么感觉？你觉得那种事还会再发生吗？

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach17
: If it does, what will you do?
lines.zh: 如果会，你会怎么做？

lines.en: : The same move I defeated you with in Miss Osaka’s class, obviously. I know your weakness now.
lines.zh: 当然是用我在 Osaka 老师课上击败你的那一招。我现在知道你的弱点了。

lines.en: : I’ve never been happier to be threatened with violence before.
lines.zh: 我这辈子从没因为被威胁要挨打而这么开心过。

lines.en: : If it is what must be done, then it will be done.
lines.zh: 若必须如此，那就照做。

lines.en: scene black
We walk for a little while longer, awkwardly bantering about how awkward it is to be awkwardly bantering with one another after so much radio silence.
lines.zh: 我们又走了一会儿，尴尬地闲扯着：在这么久的音讯全无之后，跟对方尴尬地闲扯有多尴尬。

lines.en: Not much has changed on Karin’s end. She’s still faithful, family-oriented, and so kind that I can’t help but be suspicious of her.
lines.zh: Karin 这边没怎么变。她依然忠诚、以家庭为重，而且善良到让我忍不住怀疑她。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach18
But everything has changed with me.
lines.zh: 但我这边一切都变了。

lines.en: Well...maybe not {i}everything.{/i} I still want to fuck her. I still want to {i}not{/i} want to fuck her. And I’m still fucking {i}myself{/i} by entering another scenario that can only end in one of two ways.
lines.zh: 嗯……也许不是{i}一切{/i}。我还想操她。我还想{i}不{/i}想操她。而我依然在{i}操{/i}我自己——又把自己推进了一个只能有两种结局的局面。

lines.en: Either {i}I{/i} come out on top, or she does. Either way, I’ll get my rocks off. And either way, she’ll succumb to the same divine hypnotism that compels everyone else to sleep with me.
lines.zh: 要么{i}我{/i}占上风，要么她占上风。不管哪种，我都能爽到。而不管哪种，她都会屈服于那种让所有人都想跟我上床的神圣催眠。

lines.en: That’s the only explanation after all. There’s no conceivable way all of these girls of different shapes and different sizes, treading all sorts of walks of life would somehow find their way to {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 毕竟那是唯一的解释。这些身形不同、高矮不同、走过各色人生路的女孩，无论如何想不出什么理由会找到{i}我{/i}头上。
那么……

lines.en: : Have things gotten any better for you at home?
lines.zh: 你家里的事好转了吗？

lines.en: : Did you talk to Ami?
lines.zh: 你跟 Ami 谈过了？

lines.en: : A little...but she’s been kind of candid about your situation lately, so...all I really know is she’s going to come home.
lines.zh: 谈了一点……不过她最近对你家的情况挺坦白的，所以……我真正知道的就是她要回家了。

lines.en: : Then you should know that’s all I wanted in the first place. I’m kind of a mess without her.
lines.zh: 那你就该知道，那正是我最初唯一想要的。没有她我简直一团糟。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach19
: That’s like me with Kirin. I can’t rest when she’s not around. Like...I don’t even like her staying at the dorms.
lines.zh: 我跟 Kirin 也是这样。她不在身边我就没法安心。就像……我连她住在宿舍都不乐意。

lines.en: : It’s the same with you, I’m guessing. Just...constant worrying about what she’s doing...if she’s safe. What her {i}plans{/i} are.
lines.zh: 我猜你也是一样。就是……不停地担心她在做什么……她安不安全。她的{i}计划{/i}是什么。

lines.en: : You might not be a good person, Sensei...but you’re definitely a good dad. Ami wouldn’t love you so much if that weren’t the case.
lines.zh: 你可能不是个好人，Sensei……但你绝对是个好爸爸。如果不是这样，Ami 不会那么爱你。

lines.en: : Ami loves me because she’s conditioned to love me, not because I’ve earned it.
lines.zh: Ami 爱我，是因为她被养成了爱我，不是因为我挣来的。

lines.en: : If I was a good father, I’d have called myself that years ago. Not waited until she was on the verge of shattering to step into the role.
lines.zh: 如果我真是个好父亲，我多年前就该这么称呼自己。而不是等她快要碎掉的时候才去扮演那个角色。

lines.en: : To me, it matters less what the role is called and more just whether or not you’ve been there for her. I’m sure Ami would agree with that too.
lines.zh: 对我来说，那个角色叫什么不重要，重要的是你有没有陪在她身边。我相信 Ami 也会同意这一点。

lines.en: : Ami would agree with anything that makes me look and sound better because she thinks it’s her purpose in life to just make {i}my{/i} life easier when all I really want is for her to be happy.
lines.zh: Ami 会同意任何让我看起来、听起来更好的说法，因为她觉得自己人生的使命就是让{i}我{/i}的日子好过一点，而我真正想要的只是她幸福。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach20
: See? That’s exactly what you {i}should{/i} be saying. And why I can still convince myself you’re a good guy even though you almost raped me in a karaoke booth.
lines.zh: 瞧？这正是你{i}该{/i}说的话。也是为什么即便你差点在卡拉 OK 包厢里强奸我，我还能说服自己你是个好人。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach21
: Karin-
lines.zh: Karin-

lines.en: : That’s the only time I’ll ever call it that because I know things are a little more complicated and, frankly, I just don’t like using icky words like that to begin with.
lines.zh: 那件事我只说这一次，因为我知道事情要更复杂一些，而且说实话，我本来就不喜欢用那种恶心的词。

lines.en: : But in my head, that’s what I thought was going to happen. And I need to say it out loud if I’m ever going to try and move past it. Which I want to.
lines.zh: 但在我脑子里，我当时以为那就是要发生的事。而如果我想试着翻篇，我就得把它说出来。而我想翻篇。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach22
: I forgive you, Sensei. And I won’t prevent you from actively participating in my life anymore should you ever want to.
lines.zh: 我原谅你，Sensei。而且如果你以后想参与我的生活，我也不会再阻止你了。

lines.en: : You can thank Touka for that, though. If she’d never told me about your “black out” things, I probably would have abhorred you forever.
lines.zh: 不过这你得谢 Touka。要是她没告诉我你那些「断片」的事，我大概会永远憎恶你。

lines.en: : Karin...I’m {i}still{/i} attracted to you. You know what that means.
lines.zh: Karin……我{i}依然{/i}对你有欲望。你知道那意味着什么。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach23
: I do. Of course I do.
lines.zh: 我知道。我当然知道。

lines.en: : But I also know that you’d change that about yourself if you could. And recognizing that you have a problem is the first step to ultimately correcting it.
lines.zh: 但我也知道，如果可以的话，你会改掉这一点。而承认自己有问题，是最终改正它的第一步。

lines.en: : You’re ignoring a lot of red flags to say this, Karin...You don’t know how I am with other girls like you.
lines.zh: 你说这话是在无视一大堆红旗，Karin……你不知道我面对像你这样的其他女孩时是什么样子。

lines.en: : You’re right. And I don’t really want to either since I’ve learned recently that I can’t function properly when I can only see the bad in people.
lines.zh: 你说得对。而且我也不太想知道，因为我最近学到，当我只能看见别人身上的坏处时，我就没法正常运转。

lines.en: : You can call me delusional if you like. Or maybe {i}naive{/i} or something. And honestly, I don’t think you’d be far off in saying that since I lie to {i}myself{/i} sometimes for the sake of my happiness too.
lines.zh: 你可以说我妄想，或者{i}天真{/i}什么的。说实话，我觉得你说得也没错，因为为了自己的幸福，我有时也会对{i}自己{/i}撒谎。

lines.en: : That’s why I can still smile when I see my sister even though I know she doesn’t love me.
lines.zh: 这就是为什么即便知道我妹妹不爱我，我看到她时还能笑得出来。

lines.en: : It’s why I can still hug my mom and my dad when I know I’m unfairly favored.
lines.zh: 这就是为什么我知道自己被不公平地偏爱，却还能拥抱我的妈妈和爸爸。

lines.en: : It’s why I can gleefully ignore all of the girls at school who tease me about how I’ve never kissed a boy when I have one in mind that I’ve thought about doing that with more times than I can count.
lines.zh: 这就是为什么我能兴高采烈地无视学校里所有取笑我「从没吻过男孩」的女生——而我心里有一个男孩，我想跟他接吻的次数多得数不清。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach24
: I don’t think it’s wrong to make your own happiness when the world won’t offer you any, though. So I’m okay with this delusional life so long as it keeps the color from fading.
lines.zh: 不过我不觉得在世界不肯给你幸福的时候自己制造幸福有什么错。所以我可以接受这种妄想的人生，只要它能让颜色不褪去。

lines.en: : And I’m {i}okay{/i} being the liar you’ve never imagined me to be since it’s that endless stream of {i}little{/i} lies that stave off the bigger ones that people like you need to tell themselves.
lines.zh: 我也{i}愿意{/i}做一个你从没想象过的骗子，因为正是那无尽的{i}小小{/i}谎言，挡住了像你这样的人需要对自己说的那些更大的谎言。
那么……

lines.en: : When you say you forgive me-
lines.zh: 当你说你原谅我的时候-

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach25

lines.zh: 说到底，只要我们还能够并肩微笑，那真的重要吗？

lines.zh: 怎么了，Sensei？你看起来又难过了。

lines.en: : I am, but it’s not for myself.
lines.zh: 是的，但不是为我自己难过。

lines.en: : I’m sad because the thought of a girl like you, who brings joy to so many people, can even {i}process{/i} such negative thoughts makes me hate this world we live in even more.
lines.zh: 我难过是因为，像你这样给那么多人带去欢乐的女孩，竟然也会{i}产生{/i}那样负面的念头——这件事让我更恨我们生活的这个世界。

lines.en: : How can anyone hate a world that has given them so many wonderful things?
lines.zh: 怎么有人会恨一个给了自己这么多美好事物的世界？

lines.en: : It’s easy to when it never hesitates to take them away.
lines.zh: 当它从不犹豫地把它们夺走时，这很容易。

lines.en: : Even with that, I am {i}still{/i} happy, Sensei.
lines.zh: 即便如此，我{i}依然{/i}很幸福，Sensei。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach26
: The main question now is where we go from here...

lines.zh: 那你想保持距离？因为，我不知道你怎么想，反正我并不享受这样。躲着人不是我的风格。

lines.zh: 叫我 Patrice 吧。这样能帮我维持现在这股毫无节制的怒火。

lines.en: : Is knife karate really out of the question?

lines.en: : I am not quite sure that even exists.
lines.zh: 我不太确定那东西真的存在。

lines.en: scene karinnightbeach47
: Do whatever you want. Just don’t fuck him. I need as many people on my side as I can get in this stupid fucking city.
lines.zh: 你爱怎么做怎么做。只要别操他就行。在这座愚蠢至极的城市里，我得尽可能多拉点人站到我这边。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think you’ll have to worry about that. Lesbian, remember? You’ve said it like fifty times tonight?
lines.zh: 嗯，我觉得你不用担心这个。女同性恋，记得吗？你今晚都说了大概五十遍了。

lines.en: : Trust no one. Not even the gays. I am alone in this world.
lines.zh: 谁也别信。连同性恋都别信。我在这世上是孤身一人。

lines.en: scene black
: How about I just...{i}pre-emptively{/i} buy the next round then?
lines.zh: 那我就……{i}提前{/i}把下一轮买了吧？

lines.en: : Thank you, karate lesbian...maybe you’re not so bad after all.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，空手道女同性恋……也许你也没那么坏。

lines.en: : It’s Osako. O-sa-ko. And if you maybe just want to, like...I don’t know...scribble that down on a napkin or something-
lines.zh: 是 Osako。O-sa-ko。还有，如果你愿意……那个……我不知道……把名字草草写在餐巾纸上什么的-

lines.en: : Are you seriously asking me for an autograph NOW?! In the middle of my crisis?!
lines.zh: 你现在是认真的吗？在我危机的正中间跟我要签名？！

lines.en: : Whaaaaaat? Noooo! I was just...you just keep calling me “karate lesbian” and...you know...maybe a little {i}practice{/i} would-
lines.zh: 什——么？没有啦！我只是……你一直叫我「空手道女同性恋」，而且……你知道……也许稍微{i}练练{/i}会-

lines.en: : JUST GET ME A FUCKING BEER! JESUS CHRIST!
lines.zh: 给我他妈来杯啤酒！老天爷啊！
